text: player
The Rekindling of a Hero's Heart
Hinata Takanashi
Wow, it's so busy! And everyone's outfits are so cool!
Outside the convention center
Yui Yagi
...Feels like we're in another world.
Mirai
Well, it's a major event, and it only happens once a year! I've put a lot of effort into preparing for it myself!
Wow, that person's costume is so accurate! I'll have to get a photo with her later.
At Natsuki Shinomiya's invitation, we've come to a huge comic convention in One Han City.
We make sure to arrive early, but a vast crowd has already formed. Despite being the one who invited us, Natsuki doesn't seem to have arrived yet.
That reminds me...
Aren't we missing the star of the show, though?
You're right...
Heyyy!
...Did you guys hear something?
I think someone's calling out to us, but I can't really hear them. Still... that voice sounds strangely familiar.
Oh, he's running towards us.
Natsuki Shinomiya
Hah, hah... Whew... I made it! All this gear and stuff is way heavier than it looks!
What...?
Hehehe, sorry to keep you all waiting, my dear wanderers in darkness...
...Now that I, White Night, am here, you can all rest easy!
...Huh? Why? Is there some sort of trouble?
Maybe because of the scene you're making right now, at least.
What...! My... surprise entrance... flopped?!
But I rehearsed it up to the last minute...
Well, your opening line was pretty cool, I'll give you that.
Heh, I knew you'd get it, {var:player_nickname}!
Here, everyone can dress up as their favorite characters from games or anime, take photos together, and meet like-minded people.
It's a legendary character from the iconic online game "A Lost Paradise."
Still, we sure do have an all-star lineup here.
Is everyone's "determination" flowing?
I'll need an explanation of "miracles" and "determination" first, please...
Uh...
Oh? It's your first time at a con, isn't it, {var:player_nickname}?
First-timer, same as me.
It's fine, I'll just have a look around.
I'm just happy to see everyone.
Heh, now's way too soon to give up!
You have to enjoy a rare event like this to the fullest. It's only right.
Luckily, I anticipated we'd run into a situation like this, so I brought a few back-up costumes!
...You've really thought of everything!
Natsuki looks at me expectantly, his eyes shining as he lifts up the case.
The others smirk at me with anticipation written all over their faces. It seems I have no choice...

I examine the two disassembled costumes in Natsuki's case. One gives off a sinister vibe, with a tag reading "Devil of the Tiles." The other looks like something a knight would wear and bears the name "Subsonic Belmont."
Which one should I go for?
"Devil of the Tiles"
"Subsonic Belmont"
I think I've heard this name before.
There was an unknown contestant in the national mahjong tournament who won the championship as a dark horse – mostly through a variety of off-table maneuvers.
That air of mystery made him go viral. I hear there's a ton of fan art of him online now.
I return from the changing room dressed in that costume. Seeing me, Natsuki flashes a smile of wild astonishment.
...Hehe, you surprise me, {var:player_nickname}.
I never would have guessed that you'd choose the dark side.
Well? I want to hear the deeper meaning behind this choice in your own words!
There isn't any deep meaning, really...
Of course! Evil is evil – it needs no justification. This is merely the embodiment of original sin engraved into existence itself... Is that what you are going for?
No, not at all!
I see, you possess an even higher-dimensional understanding... Wait, could it be nothing more than the unconscious act of a powerful being...?
Such is the way of the supreme and solitary. You have to admire it...
Meanwhile, our weird, intense discussion has drawn quite a crowd around us.
How do I put this... The moment I started looking at it objectively, I'd already lost.
We have an audience, I see. Can I ask you something then?
Well? Answer me!
Natsuki is as animated as a lead actor under the spotlight. Some people in the crowd even whip out their phones to take photos.
As embarrassing as this is for me... I guess it's fine if it makes him this happy.
Cosplay... training?
I've never heard of this character, but I'm really digging the whole knight look with that rapier.
With my costume on, I leave the changing room and return to the group.
...Okay, all the performers are now present.
Come on, everybody! Time to enjoy ourselves to the fullest!
We start making our way over to the main hall... but...
I can't stop thinking about Natsuki's expression from earlier.
Hey, Natsuki.
What sort of character is "Subsonic Belmont"?
He's a well-known player in a game called "A Lost Paradise."
He got so popular with the players that the devs eventually made him an official NPC.
Sounds a bit like White Night... Have you met him before?
Of course. Each of us saw the other as the perfect rival... We also fought side by side a few times.
We've never met in real life, though.
I spot a hint of melancholy in his eyes as he says this.
So... what happened between you two?
Heh...//nNothing escapes you, huh, {var:player_nickname}?
...But it's not like we fell out or anything.
It's just that I had to take a break from the game for my entrance exams.
That's important, for sure.
And it was worth it. I got into this university and met all of you guys.
Sounds like you've already moved on.
But enough about me – {var:player_nickname}, you don't seem like you've moved on yet!
Huh? Moved on from what?
Hehe, your "real self," obviously! You gotta let that go!
Cosplay isn't as simple as just putting on your character's costume and calling it a day!
Huh?! Natsuki's all fired up all of a sudden...
Only by fully immersing yourself in the role can you truly enjoy what it's like to live in that world as the character.
...Agreed.
Okay... I'll give it a try. It can't be that hard, can it?
Hehe... With the legendary White Night here, you have nothing to worry about!
The con went smoothly as well. Being an active participant really was way more fun than just watching from the sidelines.
And just like that, time seems to speed up. Before I know it, the all-day event is already drawing to a close.
Everyone
Cheers!
That's a wrap! You know, it really is nice to soak up that lively atmosphere once in a while.
...Mm-hm, that was fun.
Wait a minute... Where has Natsuki run off to now?
I've kept you all waiting long enough – time to distribute today's loot!
As for you, {var:player_nickname}...
By the way, everyone's drinks today are actually mocktails, so there's no need to hold back.
Crafting original drinks tailored to the person... Impressive.
I bet he's only this serious when he's at work!
...Delicious. Clearly an innovative combination of flavors.
Today was exhausting! Shouldn't you be getting some rest instead?
Hehe, certainly not.
I train every day. In fact, I train mentally while I'm mixing drinks...
Even after an entire day of cosplaying, your chunibyo hasn't gotten any better...!
Ahaha, that's Natsuki for you.
As everyone chats back and forth, our little party grows increasingly lively.
By the time we look up, it's already 9:00 PM – just about time for the bar's regulars to start arriving.
The man seats himself at a corner of the bar, his voice steady and direct.
...It appears you're familiar with quite a rare cocktail, sir.
Oh? Rare you say?
Absolutely. It's a blend of vodka and fresh cream, shaken over ice – a recipe straight out of the online game... "A Lost Paradise."
Regrettably, we don't have this drink on our menu...
...Is that so? And what if that White Reaper were here in person?
If I'm not mistaken, you are White Night, correct?
How do you know that name...?
Why wouldn't Thanatos know of White Night?
I-it's you?! Thanatos, the White Reaper!
I remember that name, you're...
Thanatos
That's right, as the leader of the White Night Watchers, I'm your squire.
Oh! I get it, like the president of a fan club!
An idol fansign...
I was at today's con too. I knew you were White Night as soon as I saw you.
Your performance was incredible – like your character in the game had stepped into the real world. There was no doubt in my mind that you were White Night himself.
You're too kind.
You did an amazing job today, Natsuki.
I thought it was incredible too!
Come on, {var:player_nickname}... you're flattering me.
But the real reason I came here... is to ask a favor of you.
I beseech you! "A Lost Paradise" needs you!
I-I see... But...
...On the fifth anniversary of "A Lost Paradise," the devs released a PvP mode.

White Night went on an unstoppable winning streak in ranked PvP, becoming the number one player on the entire server. People took so much pride in simply being on his friends list that they started forming fan clubs, like the White Night Watchers...
That's amazing, Natsuki! I had no idea!
But one day, White Night suddenly vanished from the game. Then... the notorious "Faceless" came out of the woodwork.
Faceless...
He's infamous for exploiting the game's bugs and unauthorized third-party plug-ins. There are reports about him all over the internet.
That's the one... Apparently, he was so jealous of White Night's skill that he challenged him again and again – but he never managed a single victory before White Night left the game.
After that, he leveraged his coding knowledge to hunt down glitches in the game and used them to do whatever he pleased.
That's not all. He gathered a band of griefers and taught them how to abuse these glitches. Now they're just running around wreaking havoc across the server.
Faceless and his cronies have even found a way to kill other players in the peace zones, meaning...
Even strictly neutral towns in "A Lost Paradise" aren't safe anymore...
How could something like this happen...?!
Shameless.
We tried to fight them, but those cheaters always had the advantage... Not even Belmont, who's basically your equal, could defeat them.
You mean Subsonic Belmont?! He couldn't either?! ...How is he doing now?
...I don't know. Not long after you left, Belmont vanished into thin air as well... No one's seen him since.
"A Lost Paradise" is losing players left and right now. If this continues, the server might get shut down...
Will you join us in the fight against Faceless...? I'm begging you!
Natsuki fills a glass to the brim with beer and gently sets it in front of the earnest-looking man.
He then proceeds to carve an ice ball, all while avoiding the man's gaze.
...Natsuki isn't acting like himself at all.
I think I understand the situation. So...
What do you think, Natsuki?
...I can't do it.
What do you mean...?
After I left, I didn't think I'd ever go back to "A Lost Paradise" again.
I had no idea... that something like this would happen.
Letting Faceless run amok and ruin the game for everyone... It's all my fault.
Sorry... I can't bring myself to face them now that things have gotten this bad.
Besides, I've been away from it so long that my skills are all rusty. There's no way I could beat someone like Faceless now.
This is the first time I've seen the usually happy-go-lucky Natsuki look so distressed.
What should I say to him?
None of this is your fault, Natsuki. It was an important stage in your life and you had to adjust your priorities, that's all.
Everyone has something that they need to focus on. They'll understand the choice you had to make.
...Yeah, you're right.
Thank you, {var:player_nickname}. Really.
Is it just my imagination, or does Natsuki's smile look a little forced?
In any case, please... just consider it!
Downing his beer in one gulp, the man leaves the bar, his words still hanging in the air.
...Haha, sorry you guys had to see me like that.
Shhhk... Shhhk...
Natsuki resumes carving the ice.
That crisp, lonesome sound lingers in the dimly lit bar.
...There's nothing for you to apologize for. You fought with everything you had in that world, I'm sure.
No one stays number one forever, but doing your best at the task at hand is just as awesome.
I think that's plenty... Besides, you take your duties at college, the mahjong club, and here at the bar so seriously as well.
It's thanks to that same dedication – and the doors it opened for you – that we ended up becoming friends, right?
...{var:player_nickname}.
That's right! And you brought us to such a fun event today!
...Indeed. It's our meeting that unlocked all these possibilities.
I agree! Gaming is just one part of life, after all.
...Thank you, {var:player_nickname}. And everyone else, too.
You're right, I finally see it clearly now...! It's no good to keep brooding like this.
It's called "Primordial Fruit: Nova."
I got the name from a revival item in "A Lost Paradise." The message of it is "the Great Resurrection."
May everyone in "A Lost Paradise" persevere through this difficult time... I know they can do it.
As expected, the cocktail Natsuki mixes up is delicious.
It's so good it makes me wish a joyful evening like this would never end.
...Even so, I can spot a shadow of guilt in Natsuki's smile.
Natsuki, I think you should give it some thought.
Huh...?
Obviously, the situation in "A Lost Paradise" getting so dire that they may shut down the server isn't your fault whatsoever.
You studied so hard for your exams that you even gave up your favorite game.
And thanks to that, we met and became friends.
However...
You're the only one who can save "A Lost Paradise" now, correct?
Natsuki – no, White Night. What are your true thoughts on all of this?
...I've considered that as well, of course...
But I don't have the strength anymore. I'd only let everyone down...
With the legendary White Night there, they'll have nothing to worry about.
No matter what happens, you never give up. You face every challenge head-on.
A nobody like Faceless shouldn't even stand a chance against White Night.
I can... still wield my sword once more?
Yep, definitely.
Do you think I'll still be able to make history after such a long hiatus?
White Night only made history in the first place by marching to the beat of his own drum, right?
...Yeah, you're right.
I'm a hero... a living legend... an omniscient, omnipotent superstar...
Well, I didn't say all that...
Very well! I accept your challenge, Faceless!
Tremble in fear as I, White Night, return once more!
The curtain rises at last... on the second chapter of the White Night legend!
Yes!! That's the White Night I know!
It's nothing... Hehe...
Wahahahahaha!!
Sorry to disturb you during your full awakening, but it seems you have a customer...?
Uh, Natsuki?
Ahem... Welcome. What can I get for you this fine evening?
In mere seconds, Natsuki has shifted back into his suave bartender persona.
I can't help but think... if he can do something like that, perhaps there's nothing he can't accomplish in "A Lost Paradise."
「Lullaby」
You were using so many classic White Night lines today that only true fans would pick up on.
Be understanding and comfort him.
So true! This is a rare opportunity, after all. I'm sure Natsuki wants {var:player_nickname} to have as much fun as possible too.
Across the street... Look, in front of the beef bowl place! Do you see that guy?!
This convention is the biggest cosplay event in One Han City.
Hinata Takanashi is dressed as a cleric from a classic role-playing game.
Mirai is cosplaying a character from a popular sci-fi anime – one with the power to control time.
Yui Yagi, who doesn't really know much about anime, has come as a summoner from the same series as Mirai. Obviously Mirai's idea.
And of course, Natsuki is here as "White Night."
This will definitely lead to the creation of new "miracles"...!
Certainly! A "miracle" is... Huh? Hold on a sec.
{var:player_nickname}, why aren't you wearing a costume?
This is nothing – White Night has been through far tougher situations than this! Here, why don't you try this on?
What are "evil" and "justice" in your eyes?
Hmm... looks like you haven't figured out how to fully get into character yet. I'll have to put you through some special cosplay training!
I'm not sure why, but a fleeting look of sadness crosses Natsuki's face before he masks it with a quick smile.
Listen carefully – cosplay is the art of syncing up your soul with your character's!
I guarantee, I'll get you to master the secrets of cosplay in no time!
Under Natsuki's expert guidance, I quickly grasped the character's backstory and some cosplay know-how.
Yeah! If there's a next time, count me in!
Sorry! Getting changed took longer than I thought.
Since Mirai's character controls time, how does the White Phantom sound? This cocktail represents "Time Eternal."
Hinata is a cleric, so I think this Distant Sunrise would be a better fit.
For Yui's character, I'd recommend the Fleeting Dream here.
To celebrate your bold first step into cosplay, I made this World Tour. It's a taste of adventure. Care to try it?
After all, even the slightest lapse will blunt my "abilities."
What's this?! I'm sensing an evil aura within a one-kilometer radius of here...!
A man who looks to be in his mid-thirties enters the bar. With his black suit and dark sunglasses, he could be mistaken for a special agent.
I'll have a White Reaper.
I'll get straight to the point – Lord White Night, might I humbly request... that you return to the world of "A Lost Paradise"?
Did something happen in the game...?
...Please, Lord White Night. You're our only hope!
Cheer him up in the spirit of White Night.
That reminds me! Who's up for trying my new cocktail?
That's what you said to me before you showed me the way of cosplay.
There's hope for "A Lost Paradise" now! We're all indebted to you, Lord White Night!
